title: MORE THAN TONGUE CAN TELL291
author: Johnathan E. Hall
stanzas: That love that Jesus had for me, To suffer on the cruel tree, That I a Ransomed soul might be, Is more than a tongue can tell!
The [bitter/many] sorrow that He bore, And oh, that crowns of thorns He wore, that I might live for evermore, Is more than tongue can tell
The peace I have in Him, my Lord, who pleads before the throne of God the merit of His precious blood, Is more than tongue
The joy that comes when He is near, The rest He gives, So free from fear, The hope in Him, so bright and clear, Is more than tongue can tell!
